decisions.reason: The mitred lever family is still listed in 2024 and fits the firm's coordinated design families, so with modest results and slack from an established hardware business there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search to drop it.
The multifunctional lever moved to a page of its own in 2024, a sign that results meet aspiration and that it fits the barrier-free and hygiene strategy.
The lever line is only mentioned rather than featured, which makes its results uncertain, but low incremental cost and organisational slack let the firm keep it in its broad certified range.
The FSB 1289 collection has kept a dedicated page in both years, which suggests strong results relative to aspiration and a central role in the coordinated door and window handle families.
